infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mingla needs location access to find experiences near you and provide location-based recommendations.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Mingla uses the camera so you can take a photo to set as your profile picture or share in a chat — for example, snapping a photo to send in a group plan conversation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Mingla uses your photo library so you can choose existing photos or videos to set as your profile picture or share in chats — for example, picking a saved photo to send in a direct or group message.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Mingla adds events you book or RSVP to — like a dinner reservation or a ticketed show — to your calendar so you get a reminder before they start. This is only used when you tap Add to Calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Mingla adds events you book or RSVP to — like a dinner reservation or a ticketed show — to your calendar so you get a reminder before they start. This is only used when you tap Add to Calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Mingla adds events you book or RSVP to — like a dinner reservation or a ticketed show — to your calendar so you get a reminder before they start. This is only used when you tap Add to Calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Mingla adds a reminder for an event you choose to save — like a dinner reservation or a ticketed show — so you get a heads-up before it starts. This is only used when you tap Add to Calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Mingla adds a reminder for an event you choose to save — like a dinner reservation or a ticketed show — so you get a heads-up before it starts. This is only used when you tap Add to Calendar.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mingla needs microphone access to record voice reviews about your experiences.
